name: Show timeline: export matches playback
description: An offline render drives each preset's keyframes from the preset's own start, as live playback does, and renders a layer track's video on exactly the frame the show says (a frame-coded clip, across a split).

steps.label: Preset B fades Wall from 20% to full over 4 s with keyframes
steps.js: (() => { const g = __show.g(); const kf = g.keyframeTimeline; const id = __show.layerByName('Wall').id; kf.setDuration(20); kf.addKeyframe(id, 'layer:opacity', 0, 0.2, 'linear', 'Opacity', 'number'); kf.addKeyframe(id, 'layer:opacity', 4, 1, 'linear', 'Opacity', 'number'); kf.play(); __show.vars['preset:B'] = g.project.saveComposition('B'); kf.stop(); return true; })()

steps.label: Live: 2 s into preset B the fade is half way

eval.true.js: (async () => { const s = await __show.snapshot(); const m = (s.mean_rgba[0] + s.mean_rgba[1] + s.mean_rgba[2]) / 3; return m > 0.45 && m < 0.75 ? m : false; })()
eval.true.label: live output brightness is mid-fade

steps.label: Exported frame at show 4 s (preset B, 2 s in) is half way through the fade, as live
Exported frame at show 1 s (preset A) is full white
Exported frame at show 2.5 s (preset B just started) is near the start of the fade
Clear the show and the keyframes
steps.js: (() => { const g = __show.g(); g.showTimeline.clear(); g.keyframeTimeline.clearAll(); g.keyframeTimeline.stop(); return true; })()

steps.label: Paused at 3 s the ramp shows media time 4 s (in-point 1 s)
Exported frame at 1 s shows media time 2 s
Exported frame at 3 s shows media time 4 s, as playback paused there did
Exported frame at 4.5 s shows media time 5.5 s
Render the frame-coded track at 30 fps
Export frame 0 is clip frame 30 (in-point 1 s)
Export frame 45 (after the split) is clip frame 75
